title: Gunnerus Open Data Set: drawings, 3D model and metadata of the research vessel R/V Gunnerus
description:
Production drawings (DWG, DXF and A0 PDF), a 3D CAD model, engineering documents and structured metadata for the NTNU research vessel R/V Gunnerus, published openly as a reference ship case for research, teaching, benchmarking and the development of digital shipbuilding tools.

Drawings and design data courtesy of polarkonsult. Derivative drawings, 3D model and engineering documents by C-JOB and NTNU. Published by NTNU.

Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0. The C-JOB engineering documents in extended/CJOB/docs/ are CC BY-SA 4.0. Commercial use requires approval from polarkonsult.

Attribution: Gunnerus open data, courtesy of polarkonsult, published by NTNU. Licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0.
